ownership.reviewCadence: quarterly and before every minor release

vulnerabilityIntake.fallbackRoute: private maintainer contact through the AlisinaDevelo profile
vulnerabilityIntake.publicRule: Do not open a public issue or discussion for a suspected vulnerability.

searchSteps: Check the support matrix for an implemented bounded adapter.
Compare the replacement semantic scope and compatibility dimensions.
Replay the replacement conformance and language-equivalence fixtures before promotion.

tabletops.scenario: The experimental adapter owner and backup stop responding while its support window is still open.

events.action: Record the missing owner and backup, freeze new capability claims, and open a governance tracking issue.
Replay conformance, identity, evidence, and compatibility fixtures; publish the observed support boundary.
Publish the deprecation notice with effective date, migration, replacement search, and support-window details.
Add replacement guidance, retain historical snapshots and evidence, and remove the active support claim.
Archive the adapter entry and fixture path while keeping the migration note and historical artifacts readable.

publicTemplates.intake: Adapter {{adapterId}} has an ownership gap. Please do not submit new capabilities while maintainers verify support and security coverage.
publicTemplates.notice: CARTOGRAPH will deprecate {{adapterId}} on {{effectiveAt}} because {{reason}}. The supported scope, migration {{migration}}, replacement {{replacement}}, and {{supportWindow}} are documented.
publicTemplates.closure: {{adapterId}} is archived. Historical snapshots and evidence remain readable; use {{replacement}} for new analyses and follow {{migration}} for migration.

tabletops.scenario: A critical adapter vulnerability is privately reported while the adapter is listed as implemented.

events.action: Acknowledge the private report, verify required fields, redact secrets, and assign a maintainer-only incident record.
Freeze the affected adapter claim, block promotion and releases, and identify affected versions and boundaries.
Publish a redacted advisory with impact, affected versions, mitigation, and disclosure coordination without source or secret data.
Ship the bounded fix, replay hostile isolation and conformance fixtures, and obtain a second maintainer review before unblocking.
Close the private report, publish release and migration guidance, and record the compatibility and security decision.

publicTemplates.intake: A private security report for {{adapterId}} was received. The project will not request secrets or reproduce the issue with proprietary source.
publicTemplates.notice: Security advisory for {{adapterId}}: {{reason}} affects {{supportWindow}}. Apply {{migration}} or use {{replacement}} while the fix is reviewed.
publicTemplates.closure: The {{adapterId}} security report is resolved. The validated fix, affected versions, compatibility result, and disclosure record are available without exposing the reproduction.
